about: Device cost model (track 0C; ROADMAP A3, AT-0C-2). Costs are render CPU-ms (wall time = CPU-ms / lane parallel). baseline predicts a render with no devices: fitted on 40 measured local renders by tests/w0c_costbench.py and tested on 20 held-out ones; a card's cost adds per device. Production lanes scale the local fit by ms_scale and stay calibrated=false until production render timings are fitted the same way.

local.basis: measured: render CPU time of 40 + 20 local renders (Apple M5 Pro, ffmpeg 9.0; best of two) at load average ~40; the 20 held-out EDLs re-measured at load 13-23 all stayed within ±25%. On an idle machine (load ~5) previews cost ~25% less CPU than this fit predicts: machine state is a lane scale (ms_scale), not a change in the model's shape. parallel is an estimate

interactive.basis: estimate: Cloudflare standard-3 vCPUs at about half an M5 Pro core; refit ms_scale and parallel from production preview timings

batch.basis: estimate: Cloudflare standard-4 (4 vCPU / 12 GiB) at about half an M5 Pro core; refit from production final timings
